SELECT A.UUID uuid, A.INF_ID infId, A.SYS_CODE sysCode, A.SEQ_NO seqNo, A.IP_ADDRESS ipAddress, A.PORT port, A.RTN_CODE rtnCode, A.RTN_MSG rtnMsg, A.DO_STATUS doStatus, A.TRAN_DATE tranDate, A.TRAN_TIME tranTime, A.REQUEST_DATA requestData, A.RESPONSE_DATA responseData FROM INTERF_RISK_LOG A
TO_DATE(A.TRAN_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_date(#{starTranDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND TO_DATE(A.TRAN_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_date(#{endTranDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.INF_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{infId}),'%')
AND A.SEQ_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{seqNo}),'%')
AND A.DO_STATUS = #{doStatus}
AND A.SYS_CODE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{sysCode}),'%')
AND A.REQUEST_DATA LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{requestData}),'%')
AND A.RESPONSE_DATA LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{responseData}),'%')
ORDER BY A.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT A.UUID uuid, A.INF_ID infId, A.SYS_CODE sysCode, A.SEQ_NO seqNo, A.IP_ADDRESS ipAddress, A.PORT port, A.RTN_CODE rtnCode, A.RTN_MSG rtnMsg, A.DO_STATUS doStatus, A.TRAN_DATE tranDate, A.TRAN_TIME tranTime, A.REQUEST_DATA requestData, A.RESPONSE_DATA responseData FROM INTERF_RISK_LOG A
A.UUID = #{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
